prompts.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset: premium 3D product illustration for the Growth Engine capability on Hamid's dark charcoal portfolio. Create one cohesive physically convincing composition: a large polished smoked-metal magnifying glass with a small warm orange grip, hovering just in front of two thin ivory browser-window slabs on a low dark graphite plinth. The front slab has a recessed search field, a simple small search glyph and a few restrained neutral interface strokes, with one orange marker; no readable words. This is a visual metaphor for search visibility and clear content, NOT a claim about rankings or measured growth. Real machined aluminum edges, brushed graphite, warm ivory ceramic, restrained orange #ff8651 detail. Three-quarter product photography, lens around 65mm, studio key light from upper left, clean soft contact shadows, realistic depth and sharp edges. Center the objects as one strong large subject occupying 85% of a horizontal 3:2 canvas, enough margin around all edges; composition reads immediately at 300px. Transparent background with genuine alpha; no environment or backdrop. Match an elegant dark website, not a toy or game. No written text, no letters, no numbers, no graphs, no green arrows, no logos, no neon, no giant glow, no robots, no abstract spheres, no watermarks.

No written text, no letters, no numbers, no floating UI panels, no paragraphs, no logos, no arrows to fake metrics, no neon, no oversized glows, no robots, no wireframe networks, no watermarks. Same restrained dark product-render family as a graphite magnifying-glass/browser sculpture.
